release_notes: Build 89 keeps the Quiz Archive Audit window open after Relink selected instead of closing back to Quiz History.
After each relink, the archive audit automatically rescans and refreshes its grid and full report in place, then selects the next row so multiple matches can be reviewed consecutively.
Relink confident Z copies also refreshes in the same audit window and always rescans immediately before applying a batch so it cannot act on stale recommendations.
Copy report uses the refreshed audit after in-window relinks.
Relinking still changes Quiz History database paths only; existing C: folders remain untouched and no archive files are copied, moved, renamed, overwritten, or deleted.
Build 88 added Exact/High/Possible deep archive matching and guarded relink controls.
Build 83 changes Full and Marathon quizzes to a 5-second default and adds safe post-upload archiving.
